plugins.name: prooftrail
plugins.description: Prooftrail — checks your AI coding agent against the rules you set, at the end of every turn. Set your rules once (tests ran, they passed, the run happened after the last edit, and more), and every session decides the mechanical ones locally and instantly, with no extra model call. Pair a hosted judge to also check the rules that need judgment, and whether the final message is supported by what actually happened. Advisory: it never blocks.
